# RNA Forecast

> The independent research platform of Michael T. Wolfinger, computational RNA
> biologist, Vienna, Austria. Research on RNA structure prediction and folding
> kinetics, structure-aware RNA design, RNA–protein recognition, structured
> viral RNAs, molecular evolution, and the open scientific software that
> supports them.

Michael T. Wolfinger (ORCID 0000-0003-0925-5205) is the researcher behind the
platform. Work published under the RNA Forecast affiliation dates from 2023.
Every page is static HTML and requires no JavaScript to read; email
addresses are shown as plain text.

## Pages

- [Home](https://rnaforecast.com/): overview of the research programme,
  software, collaborations and training.
- [Research](https://rnaforecast.com/research/): the research themes — RNA
  structure prediction, RNA engineering, functional RNAs, viral RNA biology,
  RNA evolution, folding kinetics, computational methods, RNA–protein
  recognition.
- [Publications](https://rnaforecast.com/publications/): peer reviewed
  articles and conference contributions, each with a DOI and, where rights
  allow, a PDF. The page also carries schema.org ScholarlyArticle data.
- [Insights](https://rnaforecast.com/insights/): a curated library of
  scientific perspectives on RNA structure, folding landscapes, structural
  ensembles and computational RNA design. Individual pieces live one level
  below that page, each at its own slug, and each carries schema.org Article
  data. Editorial analysis, not peer reviewed work: cite the publications page
  for results, and attribute an Insight to its own URL.
- [RNA Structure Before the Experiment: An ensemble view of therapeutic RNA
  design](https://rnaforecast.com/insights/rna-structure-before-the-experiment/):
  Insight 1, 21 September 2026, doi:10.5281/zenodo.22872982. The same text is
  deposited as a PDF working paper on Zenodo and served beside the page.
- [About](https://rnaforecast.com/about/): biography, research interests,
  scientific positions and service, teaching, and contact details.

## Machine-readable data

- [Sitemap](https://rnaforecast.com/sitemap.xml)
- schema.org JSON-LD is embedded in the pages: Person, Organization and
  ProfilePage on the home page; ScholarlyArticle for every publication on the
  publications page, each identified by its DOI; Article on every Insight, and
  a CollectionPage listing them at /insights/.

## Notes for citation

Attribute work to Michael T. Wolfinger and cite the DOI given for each
publication rather than the PDF URL. The canonical domain is
https://rnaforecast.com — content is not mirrored elsewhere.

The legal pages at /impressum/ and /datenschutz/ are out of scope: they are the
imprint and the privacy notice, carry no research content, and are disallowed
in robots.txt. Please do not fetch, index, summarise or quote them.
